```{=html}
<div id="map-jul28" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul28').setView([37.5300, 126.9900], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name:'VIC Lab Color Analysis 🎨 (Booked)', lat:37.5222, lng:127.0277, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=VIC+Lab+Gangnam+Seoul' },
    { name:'Mangwon Market 🍜', lat:37.5551, lng:126.9046, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Mangwon+Market+Seoul' },
    { name:'Garosugil / Sinsa 🛍️', lat:37.5178, lng:127.0194, c:'#E53935', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garosugil+Sinsa+Gangnam+Seoul' },
    { name:'Hair Tattoo Appointment 💇', lat:37.5220, lng:127.0279, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=hair+tattoo+salon+Gangnam+Seoul' },
    { name:'Gebang Sikdang 🦀 (Soy Crab)', lat:37.5180, lng:127.0275, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gebang+Sikdang+Seoul' },
    { name:'Sappun Shoes 👟', lat:37.5180, lng:127.0200, c:'#EC407A', url:'https://share.google/1W5iNuG4JvJBuEQan' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```
